It is one of few competitions devoted entirely to the works of a single composer, in this case, Frédéric Chopin.

Flute Sonata (Prokofiev) | The Flute Sonata in D, Op. 94, was completed in the summer of 1943 by Sergei Prokofiev.  At that same time, Prokofiev was working on music for "Ivan the terrible".  The flute sonata in D was first performed in Moscow, Russia on December 7, 1943 by Nicolai Kharkovsky (flute) and Sviatoslav Richter (piano).  It was later transcribed for violin in 1944, by the composer with the help of violinist David Oistrakh, as Op. 94a.  The violin version was first performed by David Oistrakh (violin) and Lev Oborin, Piano, on June 17, 1944.

XVII International Chopin Piano Competition | The XVII International Chopin Piano Competition was held in Warsaw, Poland on April 13–24, 2015 (preliminary round) and October 1–23, 2015 (main competition and concerts).  Prize winners' concerts were on October 21–23, 2015.

XVI International Chopin Piano Competition | The XVI International Chopin Piano Competition was held in Warsaw, Poland from October 3–20, 2010.  Prize winners' concerts were held October 21–23.  First prize was given to Yulianna Avdeeva.

Sviatoslav Knushevitsky | Sviatoslav Nikolayevich Knushevitsky (also seen as Knushevitzky; 6 January 1908 [O.S. 24 December 1907] 19 February 1963) was a Soviet-Russian classical cellist.  He was particularly noted for his partnership with the violinist David Oistrakh and the pianist Lev Oborin in a renowned piano trio from 1940 until his death.  After Mstislav Rostropovich and Daniil Shafran, he is spoken of as one of the pre-eminent Russian cellists of the 20th century.

Eric Lu | Eric Lu (born December 15, 1997) is a Chinese-American classical pianist.  He is laureate of the 4th prize at the 17th International Fryderyk Chopin Piano Competition in Warsaw, Poland.  He was also the 1st prize winner at the 2015 US National Chopin Piano Competition in Miami, USA.
XIII International Chopin Piano Competition | The XIII International Chopin Piano Competition took place in Warsaw from October 1-22, 1995.
